input.prompt: A medieval four-wheeled wooden farm wagon loaded with loose golden hay, no horse and no harness: a long plank wagon bed about 3 m long with slatted wooden rack sides (rails and uprights like a ladder), the hay heaped in a big rounded mound well above the rails and hanging a little over the edges; four wooden wheels with spokes, wooden hubs and dark iron tyres, the rear pair larger than the front pair; a short wooden draught pole about 1.2 m long sticking straight forward from the front axle, its tip resting on the ground. Weathered grey-brown oak, dry sunlit-gold hay with paler and greyer stalks. Product photo for 3D reconstruction: exactly one object, shown whole and centred with a generous empty margin on every side, nothing cropped. Three-quarter front view from slightly above (camera about 20 degrees above the horizon and about 35 degrees off the front axis), a long lens with little perspective distortion. Isolated on a plain, seamless, uniform pure white background. Soft, even, diffuse studio lighting from all around: no harsh highlights, no cast shadow or contact shadow, no floor, no reflections of surroundings. No other objects, no people, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no badges, no watermark. Photorealistic, sharp, accurate real-world proportions and materials.
